messages:
ellie_csm: Quick update — EdgeTech has verbally confirmed they want to join our private preview window starting Apr 6. Need to lock the onboarding checklist, enablement session, and weekly feedback cadence. Who can own tech enablement + validation?

josh_se: I can own the tech enablement. Need their infra contact, expected concurrency, and whether they require VPC peering or SSO.

miguel_prod: From product side — we'll want 3 representative prompt flows and the top 10 failure cases instrumented. Proposal: weekly short feedback digest (one doc + 30m sync) so we can triage regressions quickly.

ellie_csm: They mentioned SSO + audit logs as must-haves. Renewal flag: customer said they need predictable latency for launch — risk if we can't hit P95 SLA. Let's treat that as high priority.

priya_ops: I put a tentative enablement slot on Wed Apr 8 08:00 PT and sent invites to EdgeTech and their infra lead. Calendar invite + Zoom in the channel.

amanda_cs: I'll run the feedback capture — short survey + a weekly NPS pulse. I'll wire up a simple Typeform and feed results into the shared doc.

josh_se: For validation, here's a minimal runbook I want EdgeTech to complete before the session:```
- Provide one small test dataset (<= 100 records)
- Confirm VPC peering or IP allowlist
- Share expected QPS / concurrency profile
- Validate SSO SAML metadata receipt
```

miguel_prod: Also adding a small eval metric set we can run after each deploy: response latency histogram, token rejection rate, and a semantic-quality spot-check (5 prompts). I'll add a template to the feedback doc.

ellie_csm: Action owners: Josh -> infra validation & onboarding demo, Amanda -> survey + survey cadence, Miguel -> eval template and weekly digest. Priya -> calendar + invite ops. I'll lead the customer kickoff.

amanda_cs: One thought on survey cadence: start weekly for first 4 weeks, then switch to biweekly if signals are stable. I'll include that in the doc.

josh_se: EdgeTech asked about a dry-run deploy window. Can we offer Apr 5 evening UTC? Deploy team?

accounting note (ellie_csm): they asked about billing alignment for preview usage — we should loop in finance before we start heavy traffic.

deploy-bot: Deployment slot requested: 2026-04-05T20:00:00Z — queued for approval.

priya_ops: I've uploaded the onboarding checklist + Zoom link here: https://redwood-internal/drive/edge-preview-onboard. Invite updated with required pre-reads.

miguel_prod: I'll add a short template for "regression triage" to the doc so the weekly sync has a predictable agenda.

ellie_csm: Perfect. Small ask: please mark any blocker as "blocker:preview" in the doc so we can escalate. I'll follow up with a 1:1 with EdgeTech to confirm kickoff tomorrow. Thanks team :rocket:

amanda_cs: I'll prepare the first pulse now and share before the Wed kickoff.

josh_se: I'll validate SSO metadata as soon as EdgeTech sends it.

ellie_csm: Closing: next steps captured, owners assigned. Will post a quick status update in #customer-success 24h before the kickoff.

amanda_cs: :thumbsup:
